name: Steamdeck Mode
description: One button in Quick Controls turns the PC into a Steam Deck streaming host: after a 15s grace countdown it starts Sunshine and MoonDeck Buddy, gives the Deck a dedicated headless output named 'sunshine', blanks the physical monitors and covers them with a password overlay that shows what the Deck is playing. Turning it off tears everything back down.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Starts and stops the Sunshine and moondeckbuddy systemd user units
Creates and removes a Hyprland headless output named 'sunshine' and blanks the physical monitors with DPMS
Covers the physical monitors with a PAM password overlay (a layer surface, not a compositor session lock)
Holds Caffeine while the mode is on so the idle chain cannot suspend the host
Reads Steam's appmanifest files to name the running game
